albums.name: Pamplona & Basque Country, 2–12 Aug 2024
albums.description: Pamplona, San Sebastián, Arantzazu and the Aizkorri hike.

albums.name: San Sebastián to Huesca, 6–10 Sep 2024
albums.description: Road trip from the coast over Leyre and San Juan de la Peña to Huesca. Includes video clips.

albums.name: Sète, Lyon & Dole, 3–9 May 2025
albums.description: Sète, Le Grau-du-Roi, Lyon and Dole. GPS was removed from the Lyon days for the demo.

albums.name: Alsace & Freiburg, 14–25 May 2025
albums.description: Ebersmunster, Strasbourg and Freiburg im Breisgau.

albums.name: Lisbon & Queluz, 4–31 Jan 2026
albums.description: Belém, Santa Engrácia, Fronteira and the Queluz palace.

albums.name: Pyrenees, 14–27 Jul 2024
albums.description: Shared by Alex: their Núria & Queralbs photos plus the demo user's Sallent de Gállego and Panticosa days.
